{{- /*
  LeapMux override of Hextra's llms.txt.
  Links every documentation page to its clean Markdown endpoint (/index.md)
  when emitted, exposes the curated LeapMux Agent Skills (SKILL.md) and their
  companion references, and omits the non-deterministic build timestamp so
  builds stay reproducible.
*/ -}}
# {{ .Site.Title }}

> {{ .Site.Params.description | default "" }}

## How to use this index

- Open only the specific Markdown pages (`/docs/.../index.md`) relevant to your task instead of loading the full manual.
- For CLI flags and subcommands, open the specific group page under `/docs/reference/commands/` (or run `leapmux <cmd> --help` locally) instead of loading every command group.
- Use [`/agent-guide.md`]({{ "agent-guide.md" | absURL }}) when helping a human choose a deployment mode, install LeapMux, run their first parallel agent session, or diagnose issues.
- Use [`/llms-small.txt`]({{ "llms-small.txt" | absURL }}) for a compact index of the core documentation pages and Agent Skills.
- Use [`/llms-full.txt`]({{ "llms-full.txt" | absURL }}) for a guide-focused full bundle of the core documentation pages in one Markdown file (excludes per-command CLI tables under `/docs/reference/commands/`).
- Use [`/config-reference.json`]({{ "config-reference.json" | absURL }}) for machine-readable Hub and Worker configuration keys, storage backends, and all 21 Prometheus metrics (`jq`-queryable JSON).
{{- range where site.Sections "Params.llms" "ne" false }}
{{- template "llms-section-tree" dict "context" . "level" 2 }}
{{- end }}
{{- $rootPages := where (where site.RegularPages "Section" "") "Params.llms" "ne" false }}
{{- if $rootPages }}

## Root Pages

{{- end }}
{{- end }}

{{- define "llms-section-tree" -}}
{{- $context := .context -}}
{{- $level := .level | default 2 -}}
{{- $headerHashes := strings.Repeat $level "#" -}}
{{- "\n" }}
{{ $headerHashes }} {{ $context.Title }}
{{- $sectionBody := partialCached "clean-markdown-body.html" $context $context.RelPermalink -}}
{{- if or (strings.Contains $sectionBody "\n## ") (hasPrefix $sectionBody "## ") }}
{{ partial "llms-entry-line.html" (dict "page" $context "suffix" " (Overview)") }}
{{- end }}
{{- range where $context.RegularPages "Params.llms" "ne" false }}
{{ partial "llms-entry-line.html" (dict "page" .) }}
{{- end }}
{{- range where $context.Sections "Params.llms" "ne" false }}
{{- template "llms-section-tree" dict "context" . "level" (add $level 1) }}
{{- end }}
{{- end -}}
